name: Creator Toolkit
description: An editor toolbox prototype for level creators: object optimization, palette sync, and expanded color-slot workflow.

show-editor-button.name: Show editor toolbox button
show-editor-button.description: Adds the Creator Toolkit button to the level editor when the target menu is available.

confirm-optimization.name: Confirm optimization actions
confirm-optimization.description: Keep enabled while object-merging functionality is being developed and tested.

palette-sync-preview.name: Palette Sync preview mode
palette-sync-preview.description: Preview-only mode; does not rewrite level color channels in this prototype.
